mines.mine_notes: Open pit heap leach gold mine, Nevada (acquired from Alamos Gold on November 8, 2024; 100%). FY2025: produced 70,927 oz, sold 70,919 oz at avg realized price $3,411/oz (Q4 realized $4,229/oz); revenue $243.9M. Cash cost $1,937/oz; Mine-site AISC $2,693/oz (exceeded guidance $2,450-$2,550/oz on elevated royalties). 2026 guidance: ~13.9 Mt ore mined; cash cost $1,900-$2,100/oz. P&P reserves: 58,035 kt @ 0.37 g/t Au = 685 koz (probable). Head grade not disclosed in MD&A (field null).

Development-stage open pit heap leach gold-silver project, southwestern Idaho (100%). Feasibility study completed December 2025: 106 koz AuEq/yr average over 10-yr life. P&P reserves: 119,972 kt @ 0.33 g/t Au and 13.56 g/t Ag = 1,259 koz Au + 52,305 koz Ag (oxide; based on $2,000/oz Au, $25/oz Ag). No production in FY2025.

notes: FY2025 MD&A + AIF used (year ended December 31, 2025). Q4 2025 revenue $55.2M; mine operating earnings $25.3M. Costs are non-GAAP per-oz measures. Nevada North Project (exploration) excluded as non-material for mine rows. All amounts in USD.
